title: Explicit mechanics for the nine candidates with no parsed attacks
summary: None of the nine empty attack lists is an extraction failure. The conversion's attack parser only recognises 'Name (skill): damage' lines, and none of these creatures attacks with a skill roll: every one of them is a passive or automatic hazard whose mechanics the source states in prose. Each record gains explicit, runnable attack entries carrying the source's own resolution, marked autoHit where the source states that no attack roll is made and no active defense is allowed.

repairs.rationale: Not an extraction failure. The vine attacks by grappling with Wrestling and then constricting, and entangles an area with Binding 10; neither is written as a skill-roll attack line, so the parser produced nothing. Constriction damage is thrust for ST 20 (2d-1).

stats.attacks.name: Constriction
stats.attacks.notes: Constriction Attack. Grapple first with Wrestling-14, then constrict each following turn for thrust damage from ST 20. The vine has Double-Jointed and Constriction Attack; it cannot be disarmed.

stats.attacks.name: Entangle (Binding 10)
stats.attacks.notes: No attack roll. Emanation covering an 8-yard radius, usable only where the area holds dense vegetation. Victims caught in the area are bound at effective ST 10 and stay bound for roughly 100 seconds; escape is a Quick Contest against the Binding's ST. Persistent, so the binding is not consumed by one escape.

appendConversionNotes: Issue #5: the empty attack list was a parser limitation, not missing source mechanics. Constriction (Wrestling-14, thrust from ST 20) and the Binding 10 vegetation entangle were added from the source's stated mechanics.

repairs.rationale: Intentional passive hazard, not an extraction failure. The shrieker is a sessile fungus with Blindness, Mute, No Legs (Sessile) and No Manipulators; it has no offensive capability at all. Its only mechanic is an alarm shriek that penalises Hearing and draws other creatures. Recorded explicitly so the record cannot be mistaken for a broken parse, and so exports show a GM why it is harmless.

stats.attacks.name: Shriek (alarm, no damage)
stats.attacks.notes: Not an attack. Movement within 4 yards, once sensed by the fungus's Vibration Sense (Air), triggers a piercing 10-second sound that imposes -8 to Hearing on everyone within 4 yards. It deals no damage and allows no defense because there is nothing to defend against; its danger is that it attracts whatever lives nearby. The shrieker is sessile, blind, deaf and mute and cannot pursue or harm anyone.

appendConversionNotes: Issue #5: adjudicated as an intentional passive hazard rather than an extraction failure. The shrieker has no offensive mechanics in the source; its alarm shriek is recorded as an explicit non-damaging entry so the empty attack list is no longer unexplained. CER and threat tier remain at the low end by design.

repairs.rationale: Not an extraction failure. The swarm bite is built as a Cutting Attack with Cosmic (no die roll required, no active defense allowed), so the source deliberately states it as an automatic effect rather than a skill-roll attack line.

stats.attacks.name: Swarm Bite
stats.attacks.notes: No attack roll and no active defense. The swarm steps into close combat; the target automatically takes 1d cutting as large-area injury, reduced by DR normally. The only escape is to retreat or dodge-and-drop at least one yard away before the swarm acts.

appendStatNotes: Swarm: the swarm is dispersed at 0 HP and destroyed at -HP. It cannot be slammed or grappled, is immune to crippling injuries, and takes reduced damage from most physical blows (Diffuse, flying swarm).
appendConversionNotes: Issue #5: the automatic swarm bite was added from the source's Cosmic (no die roll required, no active defense allowed) construction. Rated as an auto-hit attack, which raises the offense rating over the empty-attack baseline.

repairs.rationale: Not an extraction failure. The sting is a Toxic Attack with Contact Agent and Cosmic (no die roll required, no active defense allowed), and the swarm's signature ability is Inhabit, a parasitic Possession plus corpse animation. Both are stated in prose rather than as attack lines.

stats.attacks.name: Sting
stats.attacks.notes: No attack roll and no active defense. Contact agent: the target automatically takes 1 point of toxic damage unless wearing sealed armor. Natural DR does not help unless the creature keeps eyes, mouth, nose and ears shut. Retreating or dodging and dropping a yard away avoids it.

stats.attacks.name: Inhabit (Possession)
stats.attacks.notes: Requires one minute of preparation in contact with the victim. The swarm parasitically possesses an SM-2 or larger creature and controls all its actions, or animates a corpse of up to 18 HP. An inhabited corpse grabs, lifts, strikes and throws at ST equal to its HP, uses the swarm's DX, and has Move equal to 18 minus the corpse's HP. Resolve as Possession with the Parasitic enhancement.

appendStatNotes: Swarm: the swarm is dispersed at 0 HP and destroyed at -HP; it cannot be slammed or grappled and is immune to crippling injuries (Diffuse, gnat-sized flying swarm). It seeps under doors and through screens, grates, clothing (2 seconds) and chinks in armor (5 seconds).
appendConversionNotes: Issue #5: the automatic contact sting and the Inhabit possession/corpse-animation ability were added from the source's stated mechanics. Possession is a save-or-disable effect that the baseline CER path does not price; see the encounter note on this record.

repairs.rationale: Not an extraction failure. Every offensive ability is an always-on aura or an automatic engulf, so none of them is written as a skill-roll attack line. Constriction damage is thrust for the stated effective ST 24 (2d+1).

stats.attacks.name: Engulf (Binding ST 24)
stats.attacks.notes: No attack roll is necessary; the quarry may defend only by dodging and retreating. Moving through an SM+2 or smaller creature is an automatic slam. A victim who fails to dodge is pinned if smaller than the pudding, or grappled if equal or larger. Breaking free is a Quick Contest of ST (only every 10 seconds if pinned; on a 17 or 18 the victim cannot escape unaided); the pudding has +10 ST when pinning and +5 when grappling. Engulfed victims cannot breathe and begin to suffocate when out of breath. It can pin or grapple one foe at a time; others are pushed along in front of it unless they win a Quick Contest of ST. It may constrict an engulfed victim every turn at effective ST 24.

stats.attacks.name: Acid (Corrosion Aura)
stats.attacks.notes: Always on, no attack roll. Any organic or metal creature or object touching the pudding takes 1d-1 corrosion per second; stone is unaffected. Engulfed creatures and objects take it as large-area injury. Selective, so it does not destroy what the pudding is not attacking.

appendConversionNotes: Issue #5: the automatic engulf (Binding 24, constriction at effective ST 24) and the always-on corrosion aura were added from the source's stated mechanics.

stats.attacks.name: Engulf (Binding ST 12)

A victim who fails to dodge is pinned if smaller than the ooze, or partly stuck and grappled if equal or larger. Breaking free is a Quick Contest of ST. repairs.rationale: Not an extraction failure. The jelly's only offensive ability is an always-on corrosion aura that affects flesh; it has no engulf construction in the source, unlike the pudding and the cube.

stats.attacks.name: Acid (Corrosion Aura)
stats.attacks.notes: Always on, no attack roll. Any fleshy creature touching the jelly takes 1d-1 corrosion per second. The acid dissolves flesh only; it does not harm metal, stone or equipment. Selective.

appendStatNotes: Injury Tolerance (Diffuse; Infiltration): the jelly flows through gaps and cannot be crippled, and takes reduced damage from most physical blows.
appendConversionNotes: Issue #5: the always-on flesh-dissolving corrosion aura was added from the source's stated mechanics. The ochre jelly has no engulf ability in this source and is correctly a single-mechanic hazard.

stats.attacks.name: Acid (Corrosion Aura)
stats.attacks.notes: Always on, no attack roll. Any organic creature or object touching the cube takes 1d-1 corrosion per second; stone and metal are unaffected, which is why cubes carry undigested treasure. Engulfed creatures and objects take it as large-area injury. Selective.

stats.attacks.name: Paralysis (Affliction 1, HT)
stats.attacks.notes: Contact agent, always on, no attack roll. Bare skin touching the cube must roll against HT or be paralysed for 3 seconds per point of margin of failure, then stunned with a HT roll once per second to recover. Underwater the slime is diluted and victims resist at +3.

appendConversionNotes: Issue #5: the automatic engulf (Binding 30, constriction at effective ST 30), the always-on corrosion aura and the contact paralysis affliction were added from the source's stated mechanics. Paralysis is a save-or-disable effect the baseline CER path does not price; see the encounter note on this record.
